title: Profile card
summary: Turn props into markup: a heading, a paragraph and an optional image with alt text.
prompt: Finish `ProfileCard`. Show `name` as a level-2 heading and `title` in a paragraph. Render an `` only when `avatarUrl` is given, with `alt` set to "'s avatar". With no URL, render no `` at all.
hints: Use `{avatarUrl && }`. An empty string is falsy, so it renders nothing.
The alt text is a template string: `` `${name}'s avatar` ``.
